caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate, lidded vessel or urn, rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, suggesting a monochromatic medium such as graphite or charcoal on a light beige or off-white background. The vessel features a rounded bowl with an intricately decorated surface, including floral and leaf motifs in raised relief. The base is circular and sturdy, with additional leaf patterns carved or embossed along its edge. The lid is domed and elaborately adorned with similar leaf and geometric designs, and it is topped with a tall finial resembling a cluster of leaves or petals. The overall composition centers the object against a plain background, with the vessel taking up most of the visual space and resting in the lower half of the image.
title: Stove Urn
